title: Kashmir Honeymoon Retreat
shortDescription: Seven romantic days of private shikara rides, a candlelit houseboat dinner, snow-kissed Gulmarg and quiet riverside evenings in Pahalgam.
description: Designed for couples who want time together rather than a checklist, this retreat pairs boutique stays with slow days. Expect flower-decked rooms, a private sunrise shikara with breakfast on the water, and a candlelit dinner aboard your houseboat.

In Gulmarg and Pahalgam we've chosen hotels with mountain views and fireplaces, and kept the driving light — leaving afternoons free for picnics by the Lidder river, pony rides through pine forests or simply a long cup of kahwa as the sun goes down.

price.note: Includes honeymoon inclusions. Flights not included.

highlights: Flower-decorated room and honeymoon cake on arrival
Private sunrise shikara ride with breakfast on the lake
Candlelit dinner on a deluxe houseboat
Two relaxed nights in snowy Gulmarg
Couple photoshoot in traditional Kashmiri attire

itinerary.title: Welcome to Srinagar
itinerary.description: Private airport pick-up and transfer to your deluxe houseboat, where your room is decorated with fresh flowers. Spend a quiet evening on the deck as the call to prayer drifts across the lake, followed by a candlelit dinner on board.

itinerary.title: Sunrise shikara & Mughal gardens
itinerary.description: Wake early for a private shikara ride through the floating market as the lake turns gold, with breakfast served on board. Later, visit Nishat and Shalimar gardens and dress up in traditional pheran for a couple photoshoot.

itinerary.title: To Gulmarg
itinerary.description: A scenic drive to Gulmarg. Settle into a mountain-view room with a fireplace and spend the afternoon walking the meadow or sipping hot chocolate in the snow.

itinerary.title: Gondola to the clouds
itinerary.description: Ride the Gulmarg Gondola to Kongdoori and, weather permitting, on to Apharwat Peak for views stretching to Nanga Parbat. The rest of the day is yours — sledging, skiing or simply resting by the fire.

itinerary.title: Gulmarg to Pahalgam
itinerary.description: Drive to Pahalgam through saffron country, arriving at a riverside resort on the Lidder. Spend the evening by the water as the mountains turn pink.

itinerary.title: Betaab Valley picnic
itinerary.description: A leisurely visit to Betaab and Aru valleys with a picnic lunch by the river. Optional pony ride through the pine forests to Baisaran meadow.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Drive back to Srinagar for your onward flight, with time for a stop at a saffron farm or a pashmina workshop on the way.

inclusions: 6 nights in a deluxe houseboat, boutique hotel and mountain resorts
Daily breakfast and dinner, plus a picnic lunch in Betaab Valley
Honeymoon inclusions: flower decor, cake, candlelit dinner
Private sunrise shikara ride with breakfast on board
Couple photoshoot in traditional attire (digital photos)
Private SUV for all transfers and sightseeing
24/7 Journey Boom trip support on WhatsApp
exclusions: Local union cabs in Pahalgam and pony rides
Personal expenses, tips and travel insurance
knowBeforeYouGo: Honeymoon inclusions require a copy of your marriage certificate or wedding card at some hotels
Snow in Gulmarg is most reliable from mid-December to February
Carry warm layers and comfortable walking shoes
